summary: A switch that turns a setting on or off, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x20, sm 24x16.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current on/off state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled <fieldset> ancestor disables it without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track: pill-shaped, painted unchecked or checked; holds the native input and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> covering the track; receives focus, Space, clicks and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: aria-hidden circle; sits at the start when off and slides to the end when on (mirrored in RTL).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData read in a listener already has the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end: the position, not only the color, shows the state. The thumb slides with switch.transition-duration; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. formValue(): value only while checked, else null. formReset(): checked returns to the checked attribute. formStateRestore(): restores checked. validationAnchor(): the inner input, so required -> valueMissing and the browser message come from it. isDisabled covers a disabled fieldset; disabled is not submitted. <label for> on the host is forwarded to the inner input.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty (NativeControl).

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox input; checked is exposed as aria-checked by the browser
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: on/off is announced by the screen reader from the switch role on each toggle
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of turning it on needs explaining
A compact settings list or table row
The setting must be on before the form can be submitted
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is being enabled

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for choosing several options from a list, or for agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch is an on/off setting; selecting items or giving consent reads as a checkbox (APG switch vs checkbox)

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The switch role already announces on/off; the label must name the setting, and a changing label confuses (APG switch pattern)

antiPatterns.pattern: A toolbar button that stays pressed
antiPatterns.why: That is a toggle button (aria-pressed), not a setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field and Label around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn uses bg-input (neutral-200), below 3:1; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: unchecked thumb is color.background in every mode
drift.realization: shadcn uses foreground for the unchecked thumb in dark mode; one semantic token keeps both modes above 3:1 on the neutral-500 track
shadcn uses 1.15rem (18.4px); rounded to the grid
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern for role and keyboard, the visual reference for look, sizes and API names; label row beside the track like Checkbox. No approver was available on 2026-11-12: every answer below is the recommended option, taken under SB-0011 and the session owner's instruction.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, or a <button role=switch aria-checked>?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox input with role=switch (recommended). It brings checked, required/valueMissing, disabled, label activation and Space for free, and reuses NativeControl like Checkbox (SB-0007).

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits the form, like Checkbox and a native checkbox input (SB-0009); only Space toggles (recommended). Consistent with every other form control here.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No (recommended). The attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked), same as Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes (recommended), like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name; an empty label warns in development.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20, thumb 16) and sm (24x16, thumb 12), the two sizes of the visual reference, from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens (recommended). No lg until asked for.

openQuestions.question: Label before or after the track; a label-position prop?
openQuestions.answer: Track first, label after it, mirrored by direction, like Checkbox; no position prop (recommended, YAGNI). A settings row with the switch at the end is composed with Item instead.

openQuestions.question: How does the invalid state look?
openQuestions.answer: Destructive border on the track, aria-invalid, and the error text (recommended), so the state is not shown by color alone.

openQuestions.question: Does the thumb animate, and under reduced motion?
openQuestions.answer: It slides with motion.duration.fast; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (recommended).

openQuestions.question: Share the label-row layout with Checkbox in a new mixin now?
openQuestions.answer: No (recommended). NativeControl already owns label, description and change; the remaining grid is a few SCSS lines. The form-associated rule reserves the shared option-row mixin for the first option row (checkbox option, radio option).
